sourceResearch.question: Which Gen. Business Posting Group candidates may be used for Universaarl planning without claiming setup readiness?

sourcesUsed.name: Microsoft Learn - Set up posting groups
sourcesUsed.usedFor: General Business Posting Groups define who the company sells to or buys from; General Posting Setups combine business and product posting groups to choose G/L accounts.

sourcesUsed.name: Microsoft Learn training - Set up posting groups in Dynamics 365 Business Central
sourcesUsed.usedFor: MB-800-adjacent learning context: posting groups link application areas to general ledger accounts and general posting setup maps sales and purchase G/L accounts.

sourceResearch.mcpOrToolUsed: web fallback to official Microsoft Learn pages
sourceResearch.allowedClaim: General Business Posting Groups are a source-backed Foundation concept and may be used as training/handbook context when clearly marked not setup-ready.
sourceResearch.notAllowedClaim: Do not claim INLAND or any other Gen. Business Posting Group is setup-ready, posting-ready or saved correctly from this local decision.
sourceResearch.bookBoundary: A future book/handbook section may explain the concept, but final Universaarl setup text needs playthru evidence or a separate write/reopen proof.
sourceResearch.nextStep: Prepare a Master Data write-gate boundary that keeps posting-group fields blocked or source-needed instead of treating them as write permission.
verifiedSourceNotes: Microsoft Learn still describes Gen. Business Posting Groups as the grouping for who the company sells to or buys from.
Microsoft Learn still describes General Posting Setups as the combination of business and product posting groups used to select G/L accounts.
The Learn training module still frames posting groups as the link between application areas and G/L accounts.

candidateClassifications.meaning: Domestic German business context for customers/vendors
candidateClassifications.evidenceBoundary: Foundation Readiness and setup maps use INLAND as context, and Microsoft Learn supports grouping customers/vendors by geography or type. Page 312 route recovery did not prove a setup-ready Gen. Business Posting Group page/value.
WAREN belongs to product posting group / General Posting Setup combination context, not to the Gen. Business Posting Group candidate list.
allowedUse: Gen. Product Posting Group or General Posting Setup context only
notAllowedUse: do not create or classify WAREN as a Gen. Business Posting Group

candidateClassifications.evidenceBoundary: Useful in a realistic larger company later, but no current Universaarl source/evidence basis requires these groups before the first Master Data gate.
